name: MH02b2: Known Alcohol and Substance use disorder
description:
Number of active ART clients documented as known alcohol or substance use disorder cases during the reporting quarter.
The status must indicate a known alcohol/substance-use disorder, whether receiving brief intervention/clinical management or receiving neither.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND a.alcohol_and_substance_use_disorder IN (
      'Known Alcohol or Substance use disorder on Brief Intervention and/or clinical management',
      'Known Alcohol or Substance use disorder NEITHER on Brief Intervention NOR clinical management'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
